# `csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon`

Put a base list on its own line, colon first.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget : Base, IWidget
{
    public int X { get; set; }

    public void Run()
    {
        X = X + 1;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
    : Base, IWidget
{
    public int X { get; set; }

    public void Run()
    {
        X = X + 1;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
